description: Estimate the Flying Blue Miles and XP an Air France or KLM ticket earns (set airline to KL for KLM). Miles = fare in EUR (base fare plus carrier surcharge, no taxes) x rate by level (Explorer 4, Silver 6, Gold 7, Platinum 8, Ultimate 9). XP per flight by cabin and distance band (Domestic = both airports in one country; Medium under 2,000 miles; Long 1 to 3,500; Long 2 to 5,000; Long 3 above). Give segs: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and the ISO country codes of its two airports. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Give the price in EUR, not US dollars. Unofficial.

airline.description: Airline. AF = Air France; KL = KLM.

cabin.description: Cabin. E = Economy; P = Premium; B = Business; F = La Première (Air France). XP depend on the cabin and the distance band, not the booking class. La Première is Air France only.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Air France's own: delta = Delta SkyMiles (creditStatus one of: SkyMiles Member, Silver Medallion, Gold Medallion, Platinum Medallion, Diamond Medallion); flying-club = Flying Club (creditStatus one of: Red, Silver, Gold). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. The programs follow the airline in airline (AF: delta, flying-club; KL: delta, flying-club). Give the booking class letter as creditClass. The flights are segs (their miles), or creditFlights. No price is needed with creditTo.

level.description: Your Flying Blue level. EX = Explorer (4 per euro); SV = Silver (6 per euro); GD = Gold (7 per euro); PL = Platinum (8 per euro); UL = Ultimate (9 per euro).

price.description: Ticket fare in euros (whole trip) in EUR. The base fare plus the carrier-imposed surcharge, without government taxes and airport charges, for the whole ticket. Enter it in euros; Flying Blue converts other currencies itself. Required unless creditTo is given.

segs.description: The flights, one way and in order, one entry per flight (1 to 8): fromCountry and toCountry, the ISO 3166 two-letter country codes of its two airports; miles, its great-circle distance in miles (1 to 12,500); optional cabin (E, P, B, F) for a flight in another cabin than the ticket's; optional from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports, which label the breakdown; some airlines also use them (Vladivostok, VVO, on JAL and ANA; the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle, MAD-BCN, on Iberia; the long-haul tables named by city on SAS).

cabin.description: This flight's cabin, when it differs from the ticket's cabin.

from.description: The departure airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

fromCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the departure airport, e.g. DE.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

toCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the arrival airport, e.g. DE.

trip.description: Trip. ow = One way; rt = Round trip. Round trip counts the same flights back the other way for XP. The fare above is for the whole ticket either way.

xp.description: XP you have so far (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next level.
